subject.title: Architecture: reduce import coupling in pi-embedded-runner/attempt.ts (50+ imports) and discord monitor (30 imports)

question: Should this remain the combined canonical tracker for embedded-runner import/context coupling plus Discord monitor boundary cleanup, or should maintainers split the Discord monitor work from the RuntimePlan embedded-runner RFC?
rationale: The remaining work spans two hot ownership boundaries and only partly overlaps the open RuntimePlan RFC, so automation should not choose tracker scope or sequencing.

options.title: Keep Combined Tracker
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical staged refactor covering both embedded-runner and Discord monitor coupling, with maintainers sequencing smaller PRs.

options.title: Split Remaining Scope
options.body: Move embedded-runner cleanup under the RuntimePlan RFC and open or identify a separate Discord monitor boundary issue before closing this combined tracker.

options.title: Defer Until RuntimePlan Settles
options.body: Leave this issue open but blocked on the RuntimePlan cleanup direction, then reassess whether the Discord monitor still needs its own follow-up.

recommendation.title: Keep Combined Tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical staged refactor covering both embedded-runner and Discord monitor coupling, with maintainers sequencing smaller PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current keep-open review and has the strongest recent signal across both central surfaces.
